in_hebrew.name: עולריקהומקו
in_hebrew.meaning: Light of God, My God is my Light
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Ulrikaumeko in Hebrew is derived from two roots: 'ol (light) and rakah (my God). The full meaning of the name is 'Light of God, My God is my Light'. In Hebrew scripture, this name is not explicitly mentioned, but the concept of God as a source of light is prevalent throughout the Old Testament.

in_greek.name: Ουλρικιαουμεκο
in_greek.meaning: God's Work, My God is my Work

In the New Testament, this name is not explicitly mentioned, but the idea of dedicating one's work to God is a common theme.
